title: Jonesborough History Museum

services.name: Walking Tours
services.desc: From eclectic shops along the cobblestone streets to the quaint streetlights aligning the sidewalk, Tennessee’s oldest town is packed full of charm. With entertainment around every corner including storytelling, music, theatre, historical tours, museums, award winning golf courses and much more, your experience of Jonesborough is sure to be one you’ll never forget. Town Tours - History abounds in Jonesborough. It is Tennessee’s oldest town, after all, and one of the best ways to immerse yourself in the history and the charm is through a walking tour of historic downtown.
